findings.title: OCR error diagnostics can echo credential-shaped child stderr
findings.claim: There exists a failed OCR child process whose stderr contains a credential-shaped value and whose propagated error message contains that value verbatim.
findings.observed: The witness fails: ocrPreview rejects with an error whose message contains the fake credential emitted on stderr.
findings.invariant: new: child-process diagnostics are redacted before being surfaced
findings.fix: Redact the child-process diagnostic before including it in the thrown error.
